title: Voxel Arcade shooter + VR mode
author: DRYD3N--
selftext:
Hey all, 

Been working on [www.voxodius.com](http://www.voxodius.com) for the last couple of weeks, it's a top down arcade shooter with a progressive synth soundtrack. Arade mode and a story mode, all working across mobile, web and even VR.

Used a mixture of Opus, Fable, Sol and Astra.

Astra was very good at building about some better VR HUD and implementing more complex bosses in Arcade mode (you can see Fable's work in Story mode). However I did need to get Fable to run performance improvements on the VR mode (mostly because I have a better plan with anthropic) as the initial Astra output slayed the VR performance.

LMKWYT
